About Pralux

We plan trips across India — from beaches to mountains, backwaters to deserts.

Pralux Holidays builds tailor-made travel experiences across India. Whether it is the Andaman islands, the valleys of Kashmir, the temples of Rajasthan, or the snow peaks of Himachal — every itinerary starts with a conversation, not a catalogue.

We handle stays, local transport, activities, and permits — and we stay available on WhatsApp throughout your trip. No copy-paste packages, no surprises.

Why Pralux

What makes us different.

We are not a booking portal. We are a small team that actually plans your trip.

🗺

Truly Custom

Every itinerary is built fresh — no copy-paste. Your pace, your preferences, your budget.

📞

Real Humans

WhatsApp, call, or email — you talk to the person planning your trip, not a bot.

🏨

Verified Stays

We source and verify every stay we recommend. No surprises on arrival.

💰

Transparent Pricing

You see exactly what you are paying for. No hidden charges, no surprise extras.

How It Works

Four steps to your trip.

1

Tell us what you want

WhatsApp, call, or fill the form. Tell us where, when, who is coming, and roughly what you want to spend.

2

We draft your itinerary

Within 24 hours we send a custom day-by-day plan with stay options, costs, and alternatives.

3

You refine it

Change anything. Swap stays, adjust pace, add or remove days — until it is exactly right for you.

4

We handle everything

We book, confirm, and stay available on WhatsApp throughout your entire trip.
